glosses: A custom or practice of a society or community.

examples.text: The institution of marriage is present in many cultures but its details vary widely across them.

glosses: A long established and respected organization, particularly one involved with education, public service, or charity work.

examples.text: The University of the South Pacific is the only internationally accredited institution of higher education in Oceania.

glosses: The building or buildings which house such an organization.

examples.text: He's been in an institution since the crash.

glosses: Ellipsis of mental institution.
Any facility where people (especially those who are mentally or physically disabled or sick, or who are prisoners) are committed (confined), where their freedom to leave is restricted.
Any long established and respected place or business.
